title: Product gallery accessibility candidate verified locally
summary: One-file modal focus correction passed focused keyboard/touch checks, TypeScript, lint and standard build. Ready for separate deployment approval; not deployed.

changes.detail: Initial focus, dynamic Tab/Shift+Tab containment, background and late-portal isolation, exact opener return, inert/overflow priority restoration and unmount cleanup. Focus lifetime independent of image changes. No media, product content, image optimization or purchasing logic changes.
Exact diff, complete candidate inventory and sanitized build/browser/preservation evidence. Root application worktree changes preserved.

validation.name: Gallery browser regression
validation.detail: 44 checks at 320/375/390/1440 including original defect reproduction, keyboard/arrow navigation without focus reset, repeated touch close, main-gallery swipe, zoom/pan, single image, no clipping, unmount cleanup. Zero browser console/page errors in the component harness.

validation.name: Build and preservation
validation.detail: TypeScript, focused lint and standard Production build exit 0; focused lint has no warnings. Eleven gallery/cart/delivery tests pass. Actual-build Search Overlay close/backdrop regressions pass. All other 2054 files match READY production dpl_6iS9N6cqRM5kMqPPa4ixajqkCVnT, preserving SEO, Checkout, Mobile Menu and Search Overlay. validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: No physical-device or human screen-reader test. Gallery browser checks use the exact component in a separate React StrictMode harness with real Next Image, unchanged application image configuration/CSS and public product images. Full database-backed product-page hydration and purchasing are not exercised locally because database services remain intentionally disconnected. Search preservation checks run against the actual standard local Production build with read-only public search responses forwarded in the browser; no fixtures, credentials or harness files enter candidate source. Existing unrelated full-build lint warnings and Node module-type warnings remain. The initial build failed on sandbox EACCES for Google Fonts; the normal unchanged build succeeded with network permission. Initial standalone harness setup failure preserved. No deployment, migrations, secrets, payment logic or staging infrastructure changes. SEO Release E remains on hold.
